hero_subtext: Every dollar we raise beyond running the club goes to a scholarship that helps a Triangle-area student afford life at the University of Florida. It's the single biggest thing we do.
covers_text: Each year the club awards a scholarship to a graduating high-school senior from Raleigh, Durham and the surrounding areas who is enrolling at the University of Florida. The award is paid directly to the student and can be put toward tuition, housing, books or the move to Gainesville.
eligibility_text: Eligibility: Triangle-area senior accepted to UF for the fall term.
selection_text: Selection: Board reviews applications, short essays and a short interview.
history_heading: A DECADE OF SENDING GATORS SOUTH

history_items.title: First scholarship awarded
history_items.description: A single $500 book stipend to a Wake County senior heading to Gainesville.

history_items.title: Endowed at $10,000 / year
history_items.description: Board voted to guarantee a minimum annual award regardless of fundraising.

history_items.title: Three awards, one state
history_items.description: Scholarships now support students from Raleigh, Durham and the surrounding areas.

cta_heading: HELP SEND THE NEXT GATOR SOUTH
cta_text: Donations are processed securely through Givebutter. You can give once or set up a monthly gift — every bit of it goes to the scholarship fund.
